snip.t: Systemic Lupus International collaborating clinics (SLICC) classification criteria diagnostic criteria, 2012

qs.q: Under the 2012 Systemic Lupus International Collaborating Clinics (SLICC) criteria, a person can be classified as having SLE without meeting the standard four criteria if they present with which of the following findings?
o: Pure hematological cytopenias and positive rheumatoid factor
Secondary Sjogren's syndrome with high-titer speckled ANA
Biopsy-proven lupus nephritis with ANA or anti-dsDNA antibodies
A fixed malar rash combined with severe photosensitivity alone
qs.e: The SLICC group classifies a person as having SLE in the presence of biopsy-proven lupus nephritis with ANA or anti-dsDNA antibodies. Alternatively, they must satisfy 4 criteria including at least 1 clinical and 1 immunologic criterion.
